last_attempts_log.asr_text: Wait, it ends here? Have you ever shouted that when a manga ends at an exciting moment? It says the story will continue next time. What will that character say next? What will happen to the two of them? It may be a shame to keep those ideas only in your head. The company that runs LINE Manga has announced a new service. It is called ByUs, an AI chat service for stories. It is pronounced ByUs. You can talk with characters you love. You can also make your own stories based on their works. You can leave the reader's seat and step onto the stage of making stories. If you thought, can't you already talk with characters? you noticed something important. LINE Manga already has a service called Character Chat. The company says ByUs lets you do more than chat. You can also make stories more freely. So you can ask not only what should we talk about next, but also what should happen next.

last_attempts_log.asr_text: For example, you can continue an official story on the service, or you can make your own story as a fan. What if that person came here? If it were me, I'd want to see this happen. The ideas that grew as you turned each page can now start your own stories. You may wait to see what happens next, or you may use that time to think up what happens next. You can also publish your fan stories, if you want to. You can keep them private, or let someone else read them. But things change when you make a story public. Will people understand the story? I wanna think a little more about what happens next. Before you know it, you may think like a story maker, though you began as a reader.

last_attempts_log.asr_text: Of course, you cannot use just anything you like: only works and characters approved by their original creators are allowed. The help page also says the service has permission to use the original works it features. It has this permission through official agreements with their creators. This is the base that lets you enjoy asking “what if?”. The service first offered two works and four characters in Japan. Here, taking part in a story means moving the story forward through conversations. It also means making a story as a fan. Reading a work is fun. Now, it is also fun to think up what happens next. Until now, you could only say “if it were me, I’d do it this way” to yourself. With Vias, those words can help you start making a story. What will you say to a character you love? What will happen next in the story? So, where will your next part begin?
